smart-denoise-v1.1.1-ce8e3ccd8f: Reduces coarse grain and blotchy color noise with additional low-resolution filtering.

blurry-v2.6.5-1360f00387: Smooths the background transition and preserves color at edges with chromatic aberration.

sequencer-v0.12.1-7aa90ec001: Report bugs and request features with feedback forms and a clipboard fallback.

corridor-key-v0.18.0-5559f2b3f2: Import multiple clips and queue them for batch rendering with their saved masks, crop and color settings.
